COTTONWOOD HEIGHTS CITY
PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING AGENDA
November 4, 2026
Notice is hereby given that the Cottonwood Heights Planning Commission will convene on Wednesday,
November 4, 2026, at Cottonwood Heights City Hall (2277 E. Bengal Blvd., Cottonwood Heights, UT 84121) for
its Work Session and Business Session meetings.
1. Work Session – 5:00 p.m. –Council workroom
2. Business Session – 6:00 p.m. – City Council Chambers
Both sessions will also be broadcast electronically on the city’s YouTube channel at
https://www.youtube.com/@CottonwoodHeights/streams.
Please see the reverse side of this agenda for instructions on how to make public comments.
5:00 p.m. Work Session
1.0 Review Business Session Agenda
The commission will review and discuss agenda items.
2.0 CUP-25-005 -Old Mill Demolition
3.0 Adjourn
6:00 p.m. Business Session
1.0 Welcome and Acknowledgements
1.1 Ex parte communications or conflicts of interest to disclose.
2.0 General Public Comment
This is an opportunity for individuals to make general public comments that do not relate to any
projects scheduled for public hearing under the “Business Items” section of this agenda. Please see
the Public Comment Policy on the reverse side of this agenda for more information.
3.0 Business Items
3.1 Project CUP-26-019
The Planning Commission will hold a public hearing to review and take possible action on a
Conditional Use Permit to operate a home occupation with clients (Longevity Pilates & Strength) by
Sarah Shepherd at 3295 E. Alta Hills Dr.
3.2 Project ZTA-26-005
The Planning Commission will hold a public hearing to review and consider making a
recommendation to the City Council regarding a City-initiated Zoning Text Amendment to
Cottonwood Heights Municipal Code Section 14.12.110, Driveway Approaches; and Section
19.80.030, Additional Residential Gravel Parking Areas.
3.3 Project ZTA-26-006
The Planning Commission will hold a public hearing to review and consider making a
recommendation to the City Council regarding a City-initiated Zoning Text Amendment to
Cottonwood Heights Municipal Code Section 19.89, Short-Term Rentals.
4.0 Consent Agenda
4.1 Approval of October 21, 2026, Planning Commission Minutes.
5.0 Adjourn
Next Scheduled Planning Commission Meeting: December 2, 2026.
Confirmation of Public Notice
On Thursday, October 29, 2026, a copy of the foregoing notice was posted in conspicuous view in the
front foyer of the Cottonwood Heights City Offices. The agenda was also posted on the City’s website at
www.cottonwoodheights.utah.gov and the Utah public notice website at http://pmn.utah.gov.

COTTONWOOD HEIGHTS CITY PLANNING COMMISSION STAFF MEMO
November 4, 2026
Page 1 of 4
Summary & Background
This report introduces proposed amendments to Chapter 19.89 of the Cottonwood Heights
Municipal Code (CHMC), which regulates short-term rentals (STRs). The proposed amendments
represent a comprehensive update to the city's existing regulations, intended to establish clearer
operating standards, strengthen accountability, improve enforcement, and minimize potential
impacts on surrounding residential neighborhoods.
Recommendation & Model Motions
Staff recommends that the Planning Commission forward a recommendation of approval to the City
Council for the proposed amendments to CHMC 19.89, related to short-term rentals.
Approval I move that we forward a recommendation of approval to the City Council for project
ZTA-26-006, based on the finding listed in the staff memo and attachments dated November 4, 2026.
Cottonwood Heights | Planning Commission Review – November 4, 2026 Page 1 of 12
1 19.89 Short-Term Rentals
2 19.89.010 Purpose
3 The purpose of this chapter is to regulate short-term rentals to protect public health, safety, and welfare;
4 preserve neighborhood character; and minimize impacts associated with transient occupancy while
5 allowing short-term lodging in designated locations.
MINUTES OF THE COTTONWOOD HEIGHTS CITY PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
Wednesday, October 21, 2026
6:00 p.m.
2277 East Bengal Boulevard
City Council Chambers
WORK SESSION
Chair Sean Steinman called the Planning Commission Work Session to order at 5:00 p.m.
1.0 Review Business Session Agenda.
Chair Steinman reviewed the Business Session agenda items. In addition to the Welcome and
Acknowledgments and General Public Comment portions of the meeting, there are four Business Items on
the agenda consisting of Project CUP-26-020, Project SUB-26-005, Project SUB-007, and Project ZTA-26-004.
Planner III, Maverick Yeh, reported that Project CUP-26-020 is a conditional use request for The Play
Lab, a childcare center at 2104 East Fort Union Boulevard. The property is located within the
Neighborhood Commercial (“NC”) Zone, where childcare/pre-school is considered a conditional use.
That parking agreement will need to be reviewed before the Business License is approved.
